demo.program:
# Fortran — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Fortran?", "John Backus (IBM)"),
    ("What paradigm is Fortran?", "procedural"),
    ("What is creator?", "John Backus (IBM)"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1957"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".f90"),
    ("What is hello world?", "print *, \"Hello, world!\""),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
